content:
**Done and merged: PR #81 (https://github.com/tasltd/soupfinance/pull/81), now on main as 6d33c78.**

The previous run (fix-soupfin-188-163147-wrub) was reported as "no file changes", but it had pushed a complete branch: `feature/20261013-212411-auto-fix-request-soupfin-188-issue-session`. That branch also merges SOUPFIN-49. I reviewed it, merged it onto current main, re-ran every test and merged it. SOUPFIN-49's fix therefore lands with this one.

| Acceptance item | Result |
|---|---|
| 401 sets one-shot `sessionStorage.session_expired=1` | Done in `handleUnauthorized()` (`src/api/client.ts`). Set only when the request carried a token, so a wrong password does not trigger it |
| LoginPage shows info AlertBanner, clears the flag | Done. A reload shows no notice. The banner is dismissible |
| Idle "Stay signed in?" modal | Skipped, with the reason in `client.ts`. I checked `RedisTokenStorageService.groovy`: tokens have a 30-day TTL that resets on every request, and login returns no expiry. The browser has nothing to count down to |
| i18n in 4 locales | Uses the existing `auth:login.error.sessionExpired`, already in en/de/fr/nl |
| Unit test | 489/489 pass (auth, stores, client). Disabling the flag write makes 4 of the 188 tests fail |
| Mock E2E + screenshots | 6/6 pass on Firefox. Screenshots: `soupfinance-web/e2e/playwright/screenshots/soupfin-188/` (01-06) and `soupfin-49/` (01-05) |

**Not caused by this change, and identical on a clean origin/main:**
- 34-35 reports/bills/journal unit failures. These are already tracked many times over (SOUPFIN-230, 242, 250, 257, 269, 273 and others).
- 4 TypeScript errors that stop `npm run build`, so the deploy script cannot run. Filed as **SOUPFIN-277**.

The 3650e46 commit message says it "fixed 35 pre-existing test failures". It did not; those failures are still on main.
